messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: paging to primary on-call failed for alertgroup 'prod-api-5xx' — fallback to secondary. delivery_status: webhook_403, provider=pagerx
ryan: I'm oncall, got the fallback, can someone paste the last webhook payload?
maya: jumping in. seeing 403 from paging vendor when incident-gateway tried to POST /webhook. suspect signing-rotation.
ops-bot: Deploy to incident-gateway rolled out 02:17 UTC with new signing key.
kevin: confirmed key rotation job failed to push to secrets-store (timeout).
ryan: ok, can we requeue pages? customers impacted?
maya: customer-facing 503s recorded 02:15-02:20 UTC from autoscaler flapping; not directly from paging but support reported missed pages from oncall. about ~12 customers opened tickets.
ryan: manually paged via SMS and escalated to SRE. manual handoff done.
kevin: temporary mitigation: revert signing key to previous value and restart gateway-workers. commands:
```
kubectl set env deploy/incident-gateway SIGNING_KEY=@prev-key-2025
kubectl rollout restart deploy/incident-gateway
```
maya: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/paging-integration
sre-bot: check on delivery retry queue — 14 messages pending to pagerx, 8 retries succeeded after manual replay.
ryan: confirmed pages delivered after restart. oncall claim race still observed: multiple engineers tried to claim the incident and incident-bot created duplicate incident threads in #incidents-signal.
kevin: root cause: signing key rotation job timed out and left gateway in half-rotated state. incident-bot webhook validation started rejecting tokens intermittently.
maya: actions: 1) hotfix key rotation retry + alert if rotation takes >30s 2) add idempotency to incident-bot pages so duplicates suppressed 3) follow up postmortem + customer comms
ryan: filing customer impact note to #support-ops. I'll take lead on postmortem. :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: Noted. created ticket RED-INC-2025-332
maya: closing thread once postmortem PR is opened. thanks everyone.
ryan: thanks all. :heart:
